intent: A sun-priestess's ceremonial gown of the old Grashan ruins: pale fluted stone tiers splaying into a wide terracotta hem band over a plains-green petticoat, a wide terracotta sash and a gold sun halo, reading from the high camera as a narrow-shouldered pale bell under a gold crown.
reason: Sun-halo priestess: a rayed gold sun disc behind the head, the clearest sun-worship read from every camera, over a pale V-neck bodice, terracotta belt and pleated stone skirt (second critic 6.25, first; first critic 6.45, second).
first_fix: The pleated skirt hangs straight: splay it into a flare with a stepped stone hem, and halve the sleeve blocks.
